2wiki.target_n_is: EXPECTED -- derive and verify the exact count from the archive
2wiki.reason: 398,354 is the pooled question-context universe, not the full retrieval corpus. The official 2Wiki release states para_with_hyperlink.zip contains ALL articles/paragraphs with hyperlink information except error paragraphs. The asymmetry with Hotpot was real and is resolved in favour of the full universe.
2wiki.embeddings: DO NOT discard the existing 398,354 Dense/SPLADE rows. Map them into the full corpus and reuse every exact compatible row.
2wiki.invalidates: 2wiki downstream artifacts (KNN, graph, H4, router caches, halo/SP1) -- but NOT necessarily the embeddings themselves.

hotpotqa.target_n_is: EXPECTED -- derive exact N from source
hotpotqa.reason: 'Full corpus' here means the full OFFICIAL RETRIEVAL UNIVERSE for the benchmark, not every token in Wikipedia. The introductory-paragraph corpus is what HotpotQA FullWiki indexes for retrieval; the 7.4 GB archive is broader than the intended FullWiki retrieval corpus.
hotpotqa.node_id_rationale: curid is already a source-stable identity; hashing it buys nothing and makes debugging/remapping worse.

webqsp._supersedes: BLOCKED_PENDING_FREEBASE_SOURCE (2026-09-05, lifted same day by explicit user decision)
webqsp._authority: Explicit user decision. Do not wait for an 88M-entity full Freebase dump.
webqsp.definition: The single fixed Freebase graph used by RoG and reused by later KGQA work: all triples within the maximum reasoning hops of question entities, taken over WebQSP + CWQ TOGETHER.

validation_targets._note: VALIDATION TARGETS, NOT HARD-CODED OUTPUTS. Derive from source and report any disagreement.

REJECTED_alternatives.full_raw_freebase: ~88M entities. Rejected: becomes a full-Freebase infrastructure project, and needs ~124 GB dense vs 118 GB free.
REJECTED_alternatives.webqsp_only_union: ~1.30M entities / ~3.79M triples. Rejected: the paper graph is built from WebQSP + CWQ, so a WebQSP-only union is NOT the RoG paper graph.
REJECTED_alternatives.legacy_781k: RoG TEST-split subgraph union. Rejected: query-split-derived.
REJECTED_alternatives.gold_injected_1316466: Rejected: scratchpad/c1c2_webqsp.py:30-33 injected answer + topic entities.

hard_rules: Do NOT build a WebQSP-test-only graph.
Do NOT simply reproduce the current 781k substrate.
Do NOT inject topic entities, answer entities or gold nodes. Ever.
Do NOT treat the old ~1,316,466 gold-conditioned count as canonical.
Do NOT call the result full Freebase.

connectivity_diagnostic._note: It need NOT be one globally connected graph. What matters is that it is a proper relational graph and that we know how fragmented it is BEFORE H4.

local_data_state.rog_webqsp: PRESENT: data/original/webqsp/rog_webqsp/ (5 parquet shards, train+validation+test, 494 MB)
local_data_state.rog_cwq: ABSENT anywhere on the machine. REQUIRED for the WebQSP+CWQ union; without it the build yields the rejected ~1.30M WebQSP-only union. The user directive explicitly authorises reconstructing/downloading it, preferring official RoG artifacts/code.
local_data_state.storage: ~7.9 GB dense fp16 plus SPLADE at 2.57M nodes, against 118 GB free. The full-Freebase storage blocker does not apply.

_corpus_type_declaration._why_webqsp_differs: WebQSP is fundamentally a KGQA benchmark. Published work defines an OPERATIONAL Freebase graph rather than a document corpus, so the literature-standard substrate is the correct comparable object. It must never be described as full Freebase.
